versions.changelog:
- Clarified when adjacent segments should continue from the previous generation: cuts between shots start a new chain; continuity and creator preference determine whether to continue.
- Updated completion guidance to allow local mechanical checks after this stage, with full checks after all five documents are ready.
- Revised reference guides for camera/audio continuity, delivery profiles, motion recipes, prompt grammar, and Seedance 2.0/2.5 and target-model profiles.
- Removed several sample assets and validation scripts, including the self-test, container, motion-timing, and music-spec checks.

- Refined project configuration handling: clearly distinguishes when to record and reuse model dialect, native duration, and reference modes.
- Clarified requirements for both diagram-based and text-based video generation modes, with more explicit instructions for reference image and "PLAN-..." handling.
- Clarified that, for independent non-project tasks, the resolved model and dialect are written at the top of the output for downstream validation.
- Enhanced description of the "visual rationale" field and its simultaneous update logic when new image references are bound.
- Added details about support and current limitations for "segment continuation" (video-to-video continuation) and clarified current route cannot bypass underlying limitations.
- Removed unused asset and card documentation files.
Authorized ZenStory cold-start distribution; immutable source and preserved notices.
